name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2477: The render gate blocked a push on the inbox target, and it was RIGHT and PRE-EXISTING - red at origin/main too. It had been passing only because the render gate reused a persistent Chrome profile, so accumulated browser state was hiding it; v2475 made that profile temporary and the defect surfaced. Measured at 1120x628 with the gates own fixture: max-height resolved to 208px from calc(100vh - hdr-h - dock-h - 48), which assumes the panel begins under the header. It begins where its containing block does, at 361 rather than 245, so 106px of the budget was spent on space the panel never occupies. The box ran to 569 in a 541 viewport and the Both button landed at 521..547 where elementFromPoint returned dock-handle - unclickable. The budget now subtracts the panels OWN measured top, published by the same observer idiom hdr-h already uses. Because the panel is now shorter than its content it carries a conditional fade, set from what the box actually does, because a strip that hides content owes an affordance and one showing all of it must not be dimmed.
